A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, we have developed a novel vision-based perceptual system, which can autonomously recognize and locate objects in a scene, and then control a mobile robot to perform the task of moving to the objects.
we have developed a vision-based autonomous robot system, which is able to learn to perceive and control itself by using a set of self-organized learning algorithms.
we have successfully developed a vision-based perceptual system that is able to acquire percepts from a video camera and a robot arm, and to control the arm to manipulate objects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the robot’s perception and action are not two separate entities, but rather two aspects of a single, unified, embodied system.
